name: Piedmont Food Processing Center
old_description: FROM FIRST TIME FOOD ENTREPRENEURS TO EXPERIENCED FOOD INDUSTRY PROFESSIONALS
about:
Piedmont Food Processing Center (PFPC) operates a commercial kitchen incubator in Hillsborough, North Carolina. The non‑profit was formed in 2018 to manage shared‑kitchen facilities across the state, building on an Orange County facility that was established in 2011 as a joint project of Alamance, Chatham, Durham, and Orange counties.

PFPC provides four dedicated commercial kitchens that clients reserve for exclusive use, with 24/7 access. The center supplies large‑scale equipment (ovens, kettles, blast chillers) while users bring their own small‑wares. It also offers dry, refrigerated, and frozen storage that meets Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP) standards. Since opening, the incubator has served more than 500 food businesses, currently hosts about 75 clients, and reports creating roughly 180 jobs and $3 million in annual retail value.

The facility serves first‑time food entrepreneurs and established professionals producing packaged foods, catering and meal‑prep operations, and food‑truck ventures. Clients include brands such as Carolina Caramel, Seal The Seasons, Nellino’s Sauce, Cilantro Artisan Foods, King’s Pepper, The Debonair Chef, and Starfish Bakery.

PFPC emphasizes a low‑risk entry model: no annual fees, no long‑term contracts, and a community of approachable expertise that includes business coaching and direct liaison with regulatory agencies such as the NCDA, Orange County Health Department, USDA, FDA, and OSHA.
